verdict.rationale: Expensify documents point-of-spend coding: SmartScan reads merchant, date, total and currency in realtime, expenses are auto-categorized from policy and past behavior as they are created, scanned receipts auto-match card transactions, multi-level GL coding is offered, and the chart of accounts syncs daily from QuickBooks Online. However, hands-on users concretely contradict two of these claims: one reports categories are wrong about 70% of the time (airline tickets labeled 'WiFi'), and another says a few receipts took about 20 minutes to process. A third user does praise automatic receipt data entry. Missing for 10: any evidence of memo/description capture at spend time, independent confirmation that auto-categorization is accurate, and resolution of the realtime-processing contradiction.
